mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Control1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> Pirates have seriously gained a foothold at %STATION_NAME%. From here they carried out several successful operations against %VICTIM_NAME%. However, the monsters gathered for a counterattack. Their target will be the station's server equipment. If we want to receive a reward from the pirates, we need to <color=#FFFEC1>prevent the quasimorphs from destroying the computer</color>.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Counterattack1.a: The pirates have already transferred the reward to Magnum. I like these guys: for them both quasimorphs and corporations are a source of loot.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Counterattack1.b: It won't be possible to drop you off any closer. A real war has been going on at %STATION_NAME% for several days. We'll have to hurry. <color=#FFFEC1>Stop the quasimorphs before the ritual ends</color>.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Counterattack1.d: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the group of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% before the <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> is completed.

<color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> Lately, surges in quasimorphosis have been felt at %STATION_NAME%. The captain of the pirate crew told us about this. He asks for help. Apparently, this bramfatura activity attracted %VICTIM_NAME%. They have captured part of the station and are preparing to hold some kind of <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> there. You need to get to them and eliminate them before they complete the ritual. The pirates promise a worthy reward for your help.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Counterattack1.o: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the group of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% before the <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> is completed.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Defense1.after: The reward from the pirates is already on Magnum. %STATION_NAME% will serve the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> for some time to come. But people, whatever they may be, are still better than quasimorphs. Right?
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Defense1.briefin: As soon as we get you there, the attack will begin. Sensors show that quasimorphs have already appeared in certain places of %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold out</color> for a while, and their onslaught will weaken. It seems that they are not omnipotent either.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Defense1.details:
Details: Due to the public enemy status, the pirates cannot directly report that %STATION_NAME% is about to be attacked by %VICTIM_NAME%.

Our analysts discovered this information with the help of the quasimorphs themselves. They have learned to bypass the SBN filters and constantly transmit messages to the network. The Hexarchy immediately declares them fakes.

If we want to support the beleaguered pirate crew, then we should hurry.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Elimination1.aft: The pirates asked us for quite a long time about the structure of %STATION_NAME% and what we discovered there. Obviously, they can decide to capture it at any moment. The reward is already in the Magnum's cargo hold.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Elimination1.bri: We observe unimaginable leaps of quasimorphosis. We'll drop you off wherever we can. Your task: <color=#FFFEC1>kill the Duke</color>. Don’t try to be a hero and clear out the entire %STATION_NAME%, we have a clear task with clear conditions.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Elimination1.det:
Details: The Unchained Belt has had its eye on %STATION_NAME% for a long time. The pirates would like to make it their base in this part of the Solar System. The station is now in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. If they manage to capture it, the corporatists will not even notice that %STATION_NAME% is now in the hands of the pirate crew.

Only the pirates found out that the station is home to a quasimorph of the Duke class and began searching for a contractor to eliminate this monster. This is where we come into play.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Escort1.after: The pirates sent us a valuable package as a reward for saving their man. The cargo is already on board Magnum.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Escort1.briefing: <color=#FFFEC1>Escort</color> the captain to the specified location at %STATION_NAME%. Move from level to level until you are safe. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but if you see something interesting, act according to the circumstances.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the pirate captain to the safe location.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Escort1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> At %STATION_NAME% one of the headquarters of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> is located. The pirate captain in command here has carried out several successful operations against the quasimorphs. And now %VICTIM_NAME% is going to attack the station. If we take on this urgent contract, we will need to <color=#FFFEC1>escort</color> the captain to the safe location.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Escort1.objectiv: Another day, another mission against the quasimorphs. <color=#FFFEC1>Your task</color>: escort the pirate captain to safety.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Espionage1.after: The meeting with the pirate crew took place. They almost tried to bite this quasimorphic rock. Valuable cargo from them is on Magnum.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Espionage1.brief:
The signature of the igvalite has been found, its location is marked on the map. We'll try to drop you off as close to the location as possible, but we can't promise anything: the shuttle pilot is already reporting strange visions.

Move through %STATION_NAME% carefully, save your strength. %VICTIM_NAME% will certainly defend the igvalite with special zeal.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Espionage1.detai:
Details: The Unchained Belt is planning operations related to %STATION_NAME%. Despite the suppression of information by the Hexarchy, it is known that this place is in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. The pirates discovered something interesting there.

They caught the signature of an igvalite - a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It appears that the quasimorphs use this location to store energy. There is work for us. The pirate liaison offers to infiltrate %STATION_NAME% and pick up the igvalite.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Espionage1.objec: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_RaiderCapture1.a: A pirate crew arrived at %STATION_NAME%, to which the council of commanders of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> transferred control. Looks like the pirates are here to stay. We got what we were due: the cargo is already on Magnum.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_RaiderCapture1.b:
We don't know why exactly these quasimorphs remain in our reality. As a rule, the quasimorphosis subsides soon after the violence stops. But %VICTIM_NAME% has learned to overcome this limitation. You'll have to work manually.

After disembarking, methodically move forward through %STATION_NAME% and shoot everything that moves. Keep your eyes open and try to be prepared for any turn of events. Good luck.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_RaiderCapture1.d:
Details: After %VICTIM_NAME% appeared in the Solar System, the space pirates did not think long. If something can become prey for the Unchained Belt, it will become it. The pirates want to recruit us to capture %STATION_NAME% in order to use it as a base of operations in this part of the Solar System.

Here's what we need to do: walk through %STATION_NAME% and destroy it as as many quasimorphs as possible. These creatures act on behalf of %VICTIM_NAME% and it is unknown how they learned to linger in physical reality for a long time.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Robbery1.after: The pirates realized that even quasimorphs could be defeated. They gave us some of their toys. Do you feel like we were being used in the dark, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>?
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Robbery1.briefin: Walk through each floor of %STATION_NAME%, find the marked items and escape with the loot.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Robbery1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>, the pirate crew has contacted us. They offer to take part in a robbery, but we are not talking about a raid on a corporate warehouse. They want valuables from %VICTIM_NAME% at %STATION_NAME%. If we agree, we will need to <color=#FFFEC1>find the specified objects</color> on each floor of the station and evacuate with them. After this, %VICTIM_NAME% will remember us for a long time. They always remember.
mission.Pirates_Xiomara_Robbery1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> On each floor of %STATION_NAME%, pick up valuable items, then evacuate.
mission.Pirates.names: Mutiny on the Deck;Bluebeard;Morgan;Harpoon;Boarding;Black Flag;The Nine-Tails;Walking the Plank;Keeling;Scurvy;Dead Man's Chest;Black Raven;Powder Monkeys;Wind in Sails;Map and Compass;Colderstock;Saints and Devils;Not Just Robbery;Space Wolves;Letter of Marque
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Defense1.after: %STATION_NAME% is a symbol that the order of the Solar System has changed forever. %VICTIM_NAME% failed to show that humanity is capable of challenging the new masters. We received a valuable artifact from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% in gratitude for our work.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Defense1.briefing: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> colnodes have already penetrated the perimeter of %STATION_NAME%. We'll drop you off in the main strike zone. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold your defense</color> until the enemies retreat.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Defense1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %STATION_NAME% is evidence that the appearance of the Solar System has changed forever. But not all people are ready to accept that the awakening of quasimorphs directly affects their fate. The owner of the station, %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, wants us to <color=#FFFEC1>take up its defense</color> from the forces of %VICTIM_NAME%. The outcasts need a bright event, an example to corporations that they, too, are able to influence the balance of power in the System. Let's show them how wrong they are.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Elimination1.afte:
The Shedu's Thousand is satisfied with our work. %VICTIM_NAME% is in turmoil; additional forces have been deployed to %STATION_NAME%. Maybe it's time to hit it somewhere else?

The army of Gagtungr gave us a worthy reward, the artifact has already been delivered to Magnum.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Elimination1.brie: The shuttle will land wherever it can. %VICTIM_NAME% is using countermeasures on %STATION_NAME%, so we have to maneuver. Personnel occupy positions according to the combat schedule. Carry out a massacre, but get to the <color=#FFFEC1>commander</color> of these psychos. Finally a war.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Elimination1.deta:
Details: The Shedu's Thousand joined the fight for the Solar System. Now the piercing gaze of Urparp is directed towards %STATION_NAME%, which is owned by %VICTIM_NAME%.

Operators of the Shedu's Thousand say that there is a factor preventing the capture of this place. Our analysts studied the station and came to the conclusion that they are talking about the commander of the station’s defense. The Shedu's Thousand will be grateful to us if we eliminate them.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Escort1.after: The envoys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% conveyed to us the praise of the <color=#FFFEC1>Duke</color> and called for the expansion of allied relations. If we work for the future winner now, we will take a worthy place in the future new hierarchy of the Solar System.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Escort1.briefing: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has called us for a specific purpose: <color=#FFFEC1>escort the Duke</color> to safety at %STATION_NAME%. Quasimorphs will send the best warriors into battle, so be careful.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Escort1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% has launched activities around %STATION_NAME%. However, the object is in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. The rightful owners of the Solar System will not give up so easily. And %VICTIM_NAME% understands this. It seems that it is preparing an action to eliminate the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

The quasimorphs call on their faithful servants to fulfill their sacred duty. If we want to strengthen our relationship with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, we must take on the role of the Duke's personal guard. We need to escort it to the safe location at the station and protect it from attacks by the rabble of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Escort1.objective: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Infiltration1.aft: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. This is a good deal: a rock that is useless to us in exchange for something that actually works.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Infiltration1.bri:
Several infiltration teams from %VICTIM_NAME% have already infiltrated %STATION_NAME%. You need to find them and eliminate them before they take over the igvalite. The quasimorphs are ready to give out a really good reward for this stone.

I hope we chose the right side, Boss.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Infiltration1.det:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% conducts operations related to %STATION_NAME%. The object has long been in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

We have recognized the signature of an igvalite emanating from the station. It is a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It seems that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is using this place to store energy.

We can get here before the attackers and eliminate the infiltration teams of %VICTIM_NAME%. If we do this, the future owners of the Solar System will be extremely generous.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_RaiderCapture1.af: The <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> are satisfied with our work. %STATION_NAME% now resembles Pandemonium. A gift from them appeared in Magnum's cargo hold. We should try this artifact in action.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_RaiderCapture1.br: Even if the personnel of %STATION_NAME% are expecting an attack from the <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color>, the appearance of a trained operator <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color> here will be a surprise to them. Act according to the situation, be careful.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_RaiderCapture1.de:
Details: The Shedu's Thousand brings order to the Solar System for the awakening of Gagtungr. This army is increasingly gaining a foothold in physical reality.

Now the warriors of Urparp are looking for anyone who will help capture %STATION_NAME%, turning it into another bastion of the future Golden Empire.

%VICTIM_NAME% holds on to this metal piece of matter as if it were the greatest of treasures. Let us crush them, and Gagtungr will be favorable to us when he awakens.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Ritual1.after: Good job, the <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> is extremely pleased. The ritual was completed successfully. The army of <color=#FFFEC1>Gagtungr</color> can operate in this part of the Solar System and beyond. They handed the reward to Magnum.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Ritual1.briefing: You know what's at stake. The <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> must be completed at any cost. %STATION_NAME% is under the control of %VICTIM_NAME%, and it will not retreat without a fight. <color=#FFFEC1>Your task</color> is to make your way to the ritual site and hold the position until the end.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Ritual1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Ritual1.details:
Details: Warriors of the Shedu's Thousand know how the quasimorphic servants of Gagtungr maintain contact with physical reality. But this requires constant effort. An influx of gavvakh, reliquaries, and regular rituals that extract energy from the bramfaturas of the planets are needed.

Urparp senses that the influence of the bramfatura has reached its peak at %STATION_NAME%. It's time for the ritual. However, %VICTIM_NAME%, which controls the station, stands in the way.

The Shedu's Thousand calls on all available forces to ensure the Duke has the opportunity to perform the sacred ceremony. We have to hold the defense until the ritual is completed.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Ritual1.objective: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Get to the ritual site and protect it.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Sabotage1.after: Without a server, %VICTIM_NAME% has no chance of holding %STATION_NAME%. The <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> are highly aware of the sensitive infrastructure of humans due to the large number of former <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> soldiers in their ranks. They transferred something special from her arsenal to Magnum.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Sabotage1.briefin: We will try to drop you as close as possible to one of the <color=#FFFEC1>computers</color>. It will not be easy: sensors indicate that the station’s defenders are already preparing for an attack. The good news is that the locations of the computers on %STATION_NAME% are clearly visible, and I have marked them on your map. Have they chosen the role of public enemies? Show them the consequences of that decision.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Sabotage1.details:
Details: The Shedu's Thousand wants to prepare the Solar System for the awakening of Gagtungr. You can join the future Golden Empire or lose.

The army of Gagtungr is showing interest in %STATION_NAME%. %VICTIM_NAME% placed in this place what the quasimorphs called an Altar of Knowledge. The Shedu's Thousand want this device destroyed before they send warriors to capture the facility.

Our analysts have studied %STATION_NAME%. Apparently, we are talking about some kind of computer, which %VICTIM_NAME% is using for an unknown purpose.

Let's hope the heralds of Ur will mention the destruction of the device among our achievements, which will be presented to Gagtungr after awakening.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Security1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% retains full control of %STATION_NAME%. Our quasimorphic allies (or masters?) thanked us and sent valuable cargo to Magnum.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Security1.briefin: The %VICTIM_NAME% group has dispatched special squads to %STATION_NAME% to locate and seize critical equipment and data. You must <color=#FFFEC1>prevent these squads from leaving the station</color>. Generals of Shedu's Thousand will consider it a failure if even one such squad escapes.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Security1.details:
Boss, %VICTIM_NAME% is attacking %STATION_NAME%, regardless of losses. Looks like the outcasts really need something at this station. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% calls on its loyal servants to help. The quasimorphs would like to keep the station for themselves.

If we respond to the call for help, we will need to provide the attackers with a worthy meeting: hold back their attacks until reinforcements from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will arrive.
mission.Shedu_CivilRes_Security1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Prevent the colnode squads from escaping %STATION_NAME%. I will mark them on your map.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Control1.after: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. The cargo has been received. <color=#FFFEC1>Creepy</color> creatures, but I think I'm starting to get used to them.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Control1.briefing: Mercenaries from %VICTIM_NAME% are already attacking %STATION_NAME%. You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color>. Eliminate the attackers before they destroy the artifact.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Control1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has long held %STATION_NAME%. Presumably, the station is built into some kind of system that allows quasimorphs to stay in physical reality. %VICTIM_NAME% found out about this and decided to attack. Its target is the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquary</color>. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be grateful to us if we protect it.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Control1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color> - a quasimorphic artifact similar to a statue or obelisk.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Defense1.after: %STATION_NAME% was and remains a symbol that the order of the Solar System has changed forever. The <color=#FFFEC1>Hexarchy</color> will not be able to hide the truth forever. Lying will not help them when %BENEFICIARY_NAME% strikes back. A valuable gift from it arrived on Magnum, which will greatly help us in the future.
mission.Shedu_Corp_Defense1.briefing: The attackers have already penetrated the perimeter of %STATION_NAME%. We have not yet understood whether it is <color=#FFFEC1>Security Service</color> or <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color>. But it shouldn't make much difference to you. We'll drop you off in the main strike zone. As soon as you find your feet, <color=#FFFEC1>take up defensive position</color>. Sooner or later the attackers will retreat, you just need to hold out for enough time.
